composition_subtypes.role: Compute shortest distances from a, b, c via BFS on unweighted graph
Sort prices ascending to assign smallest to most frequent edges and use prefix sums for cost calculation

payload.core_composition_summary: BFS distances combined with sorted prices and greedy prefix-minimization over junction vertices.
payload.rationale: Solution coordinates BFS to get edge counts for possible walks, sorts prices to enable greedy smallest-first assignment, and iterates over vertices as potential junctions to compute minimal total cost.
